items.title: Liner Legal
items.description: Liner Legal is a disability law firm and ETIB community resource for people exploring Social Security Disability and Long-Term Disability options.
items.text: Liner Legal, founded by Michael Liner, provides disability-law information and legal services related to Social Security Disability Insurance, Supplemental Security Income, and Long-Term Disability matters. Visitors can use the linked online eligibility survey and Liner Legal website to begin. ETIB shares the resource for information and access; Liner Legal independently handles eligibility review, legal advice, and representation decisions. items.title: Access Information News
items.description: Access Information News is a weekly publication covering access information, disability inclusion, accessibility, and technology for disabled communities and professionals.
items.text: Access Information News is a weekly access-information publication and newsletter published by Aaron Di Blasi through Mind Vault Solutions, Ltd. It shares news, resources, technology, advocacy, and disability-inclusion stories for people with disabilities, accessibility professionals, organizations, and allies. ETIB is a current pro bono sponsor of Access Information News through its PWD Media Co-op. items.title: White Canes Connect
items.description: White Canes Connect is the weekly podcast of the National Federation of the Blind of Pennsylvania, sharing stories, resources, advocacy, and conversations important to blind and visually impaired people.
items.text: White Canes Connect is presented by the National Federation of the Blind of Pennsylvania and hosted by Lisa Bryant and David B. Goldstein. The weekly podcast spotlights blind Pennsylvanians and explores accessibility, advocacy, technology, education, employment, community events, personal stories, and issues that matter to blind and visually impaired people. White Canes Connect is the weekly podcast of the National Federation of the Blind of Pennsylvania, featuring community stories, advocacy, accessibility, and useful information for blind and visually impaired listeners. Episodes are available online in audio and video formats through the White Canes Connect website, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Audible, and YouTube. Listeners can contact the podcast by email or voicemail with questions, comments, accessibility needs, or story ideas. The podcast centers blind voices, connects listeners with community resources and advocacy information, highlights blind leaders and organizations, and shares practical conversations about independence, accessibility, technology, education, and opportunity. Weekly podcast; new episodes are released on Mondays. items.title: Innovative Impact, LLC
items.description: Innovative Impact, LLC helps organizations turn disability inclusion into practical, measurable workplace strategy.
items.text: Innovative Impact, LLC is a disability inclusion consulting firm founded and led by Dr. Kirk Adams. The organization helps businesses, nonprofits, and public institutions improve workforce accessibility, inclusive leadership, hiring, retention, employee development, and universal access across physical, digital, and social environments. Innovative Impact helps organizations build more accessible workplaces, stronger inclusive leadership, and better employment opportunities for people with disabilities. Services focus on workplace accessibility, disability inclusion, inclusive leadership, and universal access. Innovative Impact brings lived experience, executive leadership, and practical consulting to help organizations create meaningful employment and advancement opportunities for blind and disabled professionals. items.description: Eyes Like Mine Inc. is a Newark-based nonprofit providing peer support, advocacy, empowerment programs, and community events for blind and visually impaired people.
items.text: Eyes Like Mine Inc. is a Newark-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit that empowers blind and visually impaired people through peer support, advocacy, community outreach, education, and inclusive events. items.title: IMperfeKtlymade Foundation
items.description: IMperfeKtlymade Foundation empowers blind and visually impaired people through accessible fashion, creative opportunities, community events, and education support.
items.text: Founded by Angela Harris, the IMperfeKtlymade Foundation is an Alexandria, Virginia-based nonprofit supporting blind and visually impaired people through inclusive fashion experiences, creative-career opportunities, community events, and advocacy. The foundation produces fashion shows featuring blind and visually impaired models, develops Style Mate, an accessible styling solution, and offers support initiatives including scholarships for legally blind students pursuing creative careers. items.title: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc.
items.description: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community through accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities.
items.text: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community by creating accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities that amplify real voices and lived experiences. Through radio, podcasts, educational content, events, and outreach, ETIB promotes visibility, empowerment, inclusion, and leadership while helping reshape how the world understands blind and visually impaired people. Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. is a nonprofit media and advocacy organization empowering the blind and visually impaired community through accessible storytelling, media, outreach, and inclusive opportunities. ETIB offers screen-reader-friendly digital platforms, audio-based media, clear communication, and accessibility-centered outreach designed to reduce barriers to information and participation. ETIB creates platforms where blind and visually impaired people can share their experiences, find useful information, build connections, and access opportunities without being framed through pity. items.title: PWD Media Distribution Co-op
items.description: The PWD Media Distribution Co-op is a disability-focused media network that helps organizations and leaders amplify accessible information to blind, low-vision, and broader disability communities.
items.text: The Persons with Disabilities Media Distribution Co-op brings together disability leaders, businesses, and organizations with verified audiences to share approved content across connected media and social channels. The network is designed to increase reach, visibility, and access to useful information, opportunities, and community resources for blind, low-vision, deaf, hard-of-hearing, deafblind, neurodivergent, and broader disabled communities. Dr. Kirk Adams is a co-founder and contributes his media channels to the network. The PWD Media Distribution Co-op is a disability-focused media network that helps organizations reach blind, low-vision, and broader disability communities. The network focuses on accessible information and disability-specific audiences. Organizations interested in participation or distribution should review the official co-op information and contact the managing organization. The co-op helps disability organizations, businesses, and leaders share accessible news, opportunities, technology, services, and community information with audiences connected to the disability community. items.title: North Carolina Reading Service
items.description: North Carolina Reading Service provides accessible news, information, and entertainment through audio programming for people who are blind, print impaired, and their families.
items.text: The North Carolina Reading Service is a Raleigh-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has served the blind and print-impaired community since 1983. Volunteers read local and regional newspapers, editorials, obituaries, literature, and advertisements, while special programs cover education, technology, legal matters, vision news, and other community topics. NCRS broadcasts 24 hours a day, seven days a week through streaming audio, website listening, smartphone and tablet apps, and Alexa-enabled devices.
